name: foundations/package-builder
title: Package builder (checkout)
description: The three-step checkout: preview the chosen template, add extras, review and pay.

reviewHeading.default: Check it over, then we start

step1Intro.default: Every template costs the same and includes the same base build. Extras are optional and priced on the next step.

step2Intro.default: Nothing is pre-selected. Skip all of it and your site still launches complete in five days.

step3Intro.default: One payment, no subscription. Change your mind on any line below before you pay.

freeBody.default: A contact page and a UK-compliant privacy policy page are added to every build at no cost. You don't have to tick anything.

pagesNote.default: Contact and privacy pages are always included free — they're already in your build.

previewNote.default: Preview only — your copy, colours, logo and photos replace all of this.

payNote.default: No contract · One revision round included · Site handed over in full
